# DELETE /api/v1/orgs/{org}/public_members/{username}

Conceal a user's membership in an organization. Sets is_public=false on the org_user record.

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-075`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |
| username | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — Doer is not the target user, not admin, and not org owner
- **404** — Organization or user not found

| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | orgAssignment | middleware | Resolve org by name |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | reqOrgMembership | middleware | Check if doer is org member or site admin |
| 3 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.GetContextUserByPathParam | utility | Resolve target user by name |
| 4 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | checkCanChangeOrgUserStatus | utility | Check if doer==target OR doer.IsAdmin OR doer is org owner |
| 5 | [models](../modules/models.md) | organization.ChangeOrgUserStatus | repository | Get OrgUser record; Update is_public=false |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Publicize/Conceal: user can change own status, admin can change any, org owner can change members | authorization | targetUser.ID == ctx.Doer.ID || ctx.Doer.IsAdmin |
| Publicize/Conceal: org owners can change any member's visibility | authorization | IsOwnedBy(ctx.Doer.ID) == true |
| ChangeOrgUserStatus is a no-op if user is not an org member (no error returned) | business_logic | !has (OrgUser record not found) |

### Error Paths

- **Org not found** → orgAssignment → 404
- **Doer not org member** → reqOrgMembership → 403
- **User not found** → GetContextUserByPathParam → 404
- **Doer cannot change status** → checkCanChangeOrgUserStatus → 403
